<style id="ac-weather-inline-css">

		.ac-weather{--ac-accent:#ffc757;--ac-text:#1f2a24;--ac-muted:#707070;--ac-bg:#fff;--ac-line:#e6e9e7;--ac-zebra:#fafbfa;font-family:inherit;color:var(--ac-text);width:100%}
		.ac-weather *{box-sizing:border-box}

		.ac-weather__head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
		.ac-weather__title{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;margin:0;color:var(--ac-text);line-height:1.2}
		.ac-weather__place{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ac-muted)}

		/* ---- Current conditions panel ---- */
		.ac-now{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--ac-line);border-top:4px solid var(--ac-accent);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:18px}
		.ac-now__main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:190px}
		.ac-now__icon{font-size:2.8rem;line-height:1}
		.ac-now__temp{font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
		.ac-now__cond{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ac-muted);margin-top:2px}
		.ac-now__stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(108px,1fr));gap:12px 18px;flex:1 1 300px}
		.ac-now__stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
		.ac-now__label{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ac-muted)}
		.ac-now__value{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600}

		/* =====================================================
		   MOBILE FIRST: accordion, one day open at a time
		   ===================================================== */
		.ac-days{display:grid;gap:8px}
		.ac-day{border:1px solid var(--ac-line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ac-bg)}
		.ac-day[open]{border-color:var(--ac-line);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}

		.ac-day__head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--ac-zebra);cursor:pointer;list-style:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
		.ac-day__head::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
		.ac-day__head::marker{content:""}
		.ac-day[open] .ac-day__head{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ac-line)}
		.ac-day__head:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac-accent);outline-offset:-2px}

		.ac-day__name{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ac-text)}
		.ac-day__date{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ac-muted)}
		.ac-day__peek{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.85rem}
		.ac-day__peek .ac-icon{font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1}
		.ac-day__chev{flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;margin-left:3px;border-right:2px solid var(--ac-muted);border-bottom:2px solid var(--ac-muted);transform:rotate(45deg) translate(-2px,-2px);transition:transform .18s ease}
		.ac-day[open] .ac-day__chev{transform:rotate(-135deg) translate(-2px,-2px)}

		.ac-day__list{margin:0;padding:0}
		.ac-day__row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:9px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ac-line)}
		.ac-day__row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
		.ac-day__row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--ac-zebra)}
		.ac-day__row dt{margin:0;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}
		.ac-day__row dd{margin:0;font-size:.9rem;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
		.ac-day__unit{display:block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--ac-muted)}

		/* Desktop table is hidden on phones */
		.ac-wx__scroll{display:none}

		/* =====================================================
		   TABLET / DESKTOP: metrics-by-day table
		   ===================================================== */
		@media(min-width:769px){
			.ac-days{display:none}
			.ac-wx__scroll{display:block;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;border:1px solid var(--ac-line);border-radius:10px}

			/* separate (not collapse) so the sticky label column paints
			   over the cells scrolling underneath it */
			.ac-wx{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;min-width:600px;font-size:.85rem}
			.ac-wx th,.ac-wx td{padding:9px 10px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ac-line);vertical-align:middle;background:var(--ac-bg)}
			.ac-wx tbody tr:nth-child(even) th,.ac-wx tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:var(--ac-zebra)}
			.ac-wx tbody tr:last-child th,.ac-wx tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
			.ac-wx__metric{text-align:left;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2;border-right:1px solid var(--ac-line)}
			.ac-wx thead th{border-bottom:2px solid var(--ac-line)}
			.ac-wx thead th.ac-wx__metric{z-index:3}
			.ac-wx__unit{display:block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--ac-muted)}
			.ac-wx__day{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ac-text)}
			.ac-wx__date{display:block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--ac-muted);margin-top:1px}
			.ac-wx__cell .ac-icon{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.2}
			.ac-wx__cell .ac-cond{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ac-muted);line-height:1.25;margin-top:2px}
		}

		.ac-hilo strong{font-weight:700}
		.ac-hilo span{color:var(--ac-muted)}
		.ac-none{color:var(--ac-muted)}
		.ac-wx__foot{margin-top:10px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ac-muted);line-height:1.4}

		.ac-weather__note{padding:14px 16px;background:#fbeaea;border:1px solid #e7c3c3;border-radius:8px;color:#8a2b2b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
		.ac-weather__note code{background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;word-break:break-word}

		@media(max-width:600px){
			.ac-now{gap:14px;padding:14px 16px}
			.ac-now__temp{font-size:2.1rem}
			.ac-now__icon{font-size:2.3rem}
		}
		@media(max-width:360px){
			.ac-day__date{display:none}
		}
		@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
			.ac-day__chev{transition:none}
		}
		
/*# sourceURL=ac-weather-inline-css */
</style>

================================ */

/* WRAPPER */

    margin-right: 8px;

    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#bushel-location-select {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
    background: #fff;
    min-width: 220px;
}

/* GROUP CARD */
.bushel-bids-group {
    margin-bottom: 22px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
}

/* CROP TITLE */
.bushel-bids-title {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: #FFC757;
    color: #000000;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
}

/* TABLE */
.bushel-bids-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    table-layout: fixed;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: none;
}

.bushel-bids-table th,
.bushel-bids-table td {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
    text-align: left;
    color: #000000;
    white-space: nowrap;
    vertical-align: top;
}

.bushel-bids-table th {
    font-weight: 600;
    background: #f8fafc;
}

.bushel-bids-table tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
}

/* COLUMN WIDTHS (DESKTOP ONLY) */
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(1),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 32%; }

.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(2),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(2),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(3),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(3),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(4),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(4),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(5),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(5),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(6),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(6) {
    width: 13.6%;
}

/* CHANGE COLORS */
.bushel-bids-table td.pos { color: #1f7a1f; }
.bushel-bids-table td.neg { color: #b00020; }

/* REMOVE THEME HOVER + STRIPING */
.bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > th,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > th,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(even) > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(even) > th {
    background-color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* ================================
   MOBILE STACKED CARDS
================================ */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .bushel-bids-table {
        width: 100%;
        table-layout: auto;
        border-collapse: separate;
        border-spacing: 0;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table thead {
        display: none;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table,
    .bushel-bids-table tbody,
    .bushel-bids-table tr,
    .bushel-bids-table td {
        display: block;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100%;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table th,
    .bushel-bids-table td {
        width: 100% !important;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table tbody {
        padding: 8px;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table tr {
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
        border-radius: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td {
        white-space: normal;
        word-break: break-word;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #eeeeee;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        padding-left: 44%;
        position: relative;
        min-height: 40px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        text-align: left;
        background: #ffffff;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td::before {
        position: absolute;
        left: 12px;
        top: 10px;
        width: 36%;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #111827;
        line-height: 1.25;
        white-space: normal;
        content: "";
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1)::before { content: "Delivery"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(2)::before { content: "Bid"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(3)::before { content: "Basis"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(4)::before { content: "Futures"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(5)::before { content: "Change"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(6)::before { content: "Month"; }

    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1) {
        background-color: #f1f3f5;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > td {
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table * {
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
}

/* ================================
   BUSHEL TICKER STYLES
================================ */

.bushel-ticker {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #020617;
    color: #fff;
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

.bushel-ticker-inner {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.bushel-ticker-track {
    display: inline-flex;
    white-space: nowrap;
    animation: bushel-ticker-scroll 32s linear infinite;
}

.bushel-ticker-group {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 1.1rem;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.bushel-ticker-group:last-child {
    border-right: none;
}

.bushel-ticker-group .loc-pill {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--loc-color, #FFC757);
    color: #020617;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: none;
}

.bushel-ticker-group .crop {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.bushel-ticker-group .bid {
    opacity: 0.95;
}

@keyframes bushel-ticker-scroll {
    0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .bushel-ticker-track {
        animation: none;
    }

<style id="wp-custom-css">
/* ================================
   BUSHEL CASH BIDS TABLE STYLES
================================ */

/* WRAPPER */
.bushel-bids-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
}

/* LOCATION SELECTOR */
.bushel-bids-header {
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.bushel-bids-header label {
    margin-right: 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#bushel-location-select {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
    background: #fff;
    min-width: 220px;
}

/* GROUP CARD */
.bushel-bids-group {
    margin-bottom: 22px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
}

/* CROP TITLE */
.bushel-bids-title {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: #FFC757;
    color: #000000;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
}

/* TABLE */
.bushel-bids-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    table-layout: fixed;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: none;
}

.bushel-bids-table th,
.bushel-bids-table td {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
    text-align: left;
    color: #000000;
    white-space: nowrap;
    vertical-align: top;
}

.bushel-bids-table th {
    font-weight: 600;
    background: #f8fafc;
}

.bushel-bids-table tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
}

/* COLUMN WIDTHS (DESKTOP ONLY) */
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(1),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 32%; }

.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(2),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(2),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(3),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(3),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(4),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(4),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(5),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(5),
.bushel-bids-table th:nth-child(6),
.bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(6) {
    width: 13.6%;
}

/* CHANGE COLORS */
.bushel-bids-table td.pos { color: #1f7a1f; }
.bushel-bids-table td.neg { color: #b00020; }

/* REMOVE THEME HOVER + STRIPING */
.bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > th,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > th,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(even) > td,
.bushel-bids-table tbody > tr:nth-child(even) > th {

}

/* ================================
   MOBILE STACKED CARDS (FIXED)
================================ */

@media (max-width: 768px) {

    /* RESET TABLE STRUCTURE */
    .bushel-bids-table {
        width: 100%;
        table-layout: auto;
        border-collapse: separate;
        border-spacing: 0;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table thead {
        display: none;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table,
    .bushel-bids-table tbody,
    .bushel-bids-table tr,
    .bushel-bids-table td {
        display: block;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100%;
    }

    /* 🔥 CRITICAL FIX: KILL DESKTOP WIDTHS */
    .bushel-bids-table th,
    .bushel-bids-table td {
        width: 100% !important;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table tbody {
        padding: 8px;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table tr {
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
        border-radius: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td {
        white-space: normal;
        word-break: break-word;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #eeeeee;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        padding-left: 44%;
        position: relative;
        min-height: 40px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        text-align: left;
        background: #ffffff;
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    /* LABELS */
    .bushel-bids-table td::before {
        position: absolute;
        left: 12px;
        top: 10px;
        width: 36%;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #111827;
        line-height: 1.25;
        white-space: normal;
        content: "";
    }

    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1)::before { content: "Delivery"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(2)::before { content: "Bid"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(3)::before { content: "Basis"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(4)::before { content: "Futures"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(5)::before { content: "Change"; }
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(6)::before { content: "Month"; }

    /* DELIVERY ROW HIGHLIGHT */
    .bushel-bids-table td:nth-child(1) {
        background-color: #f1f3f5;
        font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* REMOVE TAP / HOVER ARTIFACTS */
    .bushel-bids-table tbody tr:hover > td {

    }

    .bushel-bids-table * {
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
}

/* ===== PDF Library — override theme styling ===================== */

.pdfl .pdfl__field input.pdfl__input,

	border: 0 !important;
	border-radius: 0 !important;
	box-shadow: none !important;

}

	border: 0 !important;
	box-shadow: none !important;
	outline: 0 !important;
}

/* 2. Next / previous buttons — reset theme button chrome and force the
      icon colour so the arrows are actually visible. */
.pdfl .pdfl__nav button.pdfl__step {

	align-items: center !important;
	justify-content: center !important;
	width: 42px !important;
	height: 42px !important;

	background: #fff !important;
	color: var(--pdfl-ink) !important;
	box-shadow: none !important;
	text-transform: none !important;
	letter-spacing: normal !important;
	line-height: 0 !important;
}

.pdfl .pdfl__nav button.pdfl__step svg {

	width: 16px !important;
	height: 16px !important;
	fill: none !important;
	stroke: currentColor !important;
	stroke-width: 2 !important;
}

.pdfl .pdfl__nav button.pdfl__step:hover:not(:disabled) {
	background: #f6f7f9 !important;
	border-color: #646c78 !important;
}

.pdfl .pdfl__nav button.pdfl__step:disabled {

							<div class="elementor-shortcode">		<div id="bushel-bids-container" class="bushel-bids-loading">
			<div class="bushel-bids-placeholder">Loading cash bids…</div>
		</div>

		<script>
		(function(){
			const container = document.getElementById('bushel-bids-container');
			const ajaxUrl = "https://arthurcompanies.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php";
			const remember = true;
			const defaultLoc = "Arthur";
			const storageKey = 'bushelPreferredLocation';

			function load(loc){
				fetch(ajaxUrl + '?action=bushel_get_bids&location=' + encodeURIComponent(loc), { cache: 'no-store' })
					.then(r => r.json())
					.then(d => {
						if (d && d.success && d.data && d.data.html) {
							container.classList.remove('bushel-bids-loading');
							container.innerHTML = d.data.html;
							bind();
						}
					})
					.catch(function(){
						container.innerHTML = '<div class="bushel-bids-error">Cash bids are temporarily unavailable. Please refresh.</div>';
					});
			}

			function bind(){
				const sel = container.querySelector('#bushel-location-select');
				if (!sel) return;

				sel.addEventListener('change', function(){
					const loc = this.value;
					if (remember) {
						try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, loc); } catch(e) {}
					}
					load(loc);
				});
			}

			function initialLocation(){
				if (remember) {
					try {
						const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
						if (saved) return saved;
					} catch(e) {}
				}
				return defaultLoc;
			}

			// Load bids on page load — the initial HTML is just an empty shell,
			// so cached page HTML never contains stale prices.
			load(initialLocation());
		})();
		</script>

			.unlimited-elements-background-overlay{
				position:absolute;
				top:0px;
				left:0px;
				width:100%;
				height:100%;
				z-index:0;
			}

			.unlimited-elements-background-overlay.uc-bg-front{
				z-index:999;
			}

		<script type='text/javascript'>

			jQuery(document).ready(function(){
					
				function ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart(){
				
					var objBG = jQuery(".unlimited-elements-background-overlay").not(".uc-bg-attached");

					if(objBG.length == 0)
						return(false);

					objBG.each(function(index, bgElement){

						var objBgElement = jQuery(bgElement);

						var targetID = objBgElement.data("forid");

						var location = objBgElement.data("location");

						switch(location){
							case "body":
							case "body_front":
								var objTarget = jQuery("body");
							break;
							case "layout":
							case "layout_front":
								var objLayout = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
								var objTarget = objLayout.parents(".elementor");
								if(objTarget.length > 1)
									objTarget = jQuery(objTarget[0]);
							break;
							default:
								var objTarget = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
							break;
						}


						if(objTarget.length == 0)
							return(true);

						var objVideoContainer = objTarget.children(".elementor-background-video-container");

						if(objVideoContainer.length == 1)
							objBgElement.detach().insertAfter(objVideoContainer).show();
						else
							objBgElement.detach().prependTo(objTarget).show();


						var objTemplate = objBgElement.children("template");

						if(objTemplate.length){
							
					        var clonedContent = objTemplate[0].content.cloneNode(true);

					    	var objScripts = jQuery(clonedContent).find("script");
					    	if(objScripts.length)
					    		objScripts.attr("type","text/javascript");
					        
					        objBgElement.append(clonedContent);
							
							objTemplate.remove();
						}

						objBgElement.trigger("bg_attached");
						objBgElement.addClass("uc-bg-attached");

					});
				}

				ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart();

				jQuery( document ).on( 'elementor/popup/show', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);
				jQuery( "body" ).on( 'uc_dom_updated', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);

			});


		</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var body = document.body;
  var header = document.querySelector('.mega_selector');
  var megaDrops = document.querySelectorAll('.mega_drop');

  if (!header || !megaDrops.length) return;

  var closeTimeout = null;
  var CLOSE_DELAY  = 250; // a bit more forgiving than 120

  function cancelClose() {
    if (closeTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(closeTimeout);
      closeTimeout = null;
    }
  }

  function openMega() {
    cancelClose();
    body.classList.add('has-mega-open');
    header.classList.add('mega-open');
  }

  function scheduleClose() {
    if (closeTimeout) return;
    closeTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
      body.classList.remove('has-mega-open');
      header.classList.remove('mega-open');
      closeTimeout = null;
    }, CLOSE_DELAY);
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < megaDrops.length; i++) {
    var drop = megaDrops[i];
    var item = drop.closest('.e-n-menu-item');
    if (!item) continue;

    // open when hovering the menu item
    item.addEventListener('mouseenter', openMega);

    // IMPORTANT: don't immediately close when leaving the item;
    // allow the dropdown itself to "hold" the open state.
    item.addEventListener('mouseleave', scheduleClose);

    // NEW: hovering the mega panel keeps it open
    drop.addEventListener('mouseenter', openMega);
    drop.addEventListener('mouseleave', scheduleClose);
  }

  // header also keeps/cancels close
  header.addEventListener('mouseenter', cancelClose);
  header.addEventListener('mouseleave', scheduleClose);
});
</script>
